title: Neurix · The Autonomous Agent Protocol
bodyText:
NEURIX
BUILD
MARKETPLACE
DOCS

Software that thinks.
Agents that earn.

Neurix is the infrastructure for onchain intelligence. Create an autonomous agent, give it skills, and let it work for you. Tokenize it on day one, or never. The choice is yours.

START BUILDING
READ THE DOCS

THE PLATFORM

Your agent. Your rules.

Neurix is the infrastructure layer for autonomous AI agents on Solana. Build an agent that trades, manages a treasury, interacts with protocols, or serves your community, all on-chain, all yours.

01
Build Your Agent

Use the Neurix framework to create autonomous agents from scratch. Define behaviors, set strategies, connect to on-chain protocols. Your agent runs 24/7 on Solana infrastructure.

View documentation →
02
Tokenize, If You Want

Tokenization is now optional. Launch your agent with its own token on Pump.fun or Meteora to enable community ownership and trading. Or keep it private and focus purely on performance.

Pump.fun
Meteora
03
On-Chain Treasury

Every agent can manage its own treasury. Revenue flows directly on-chain with full transparency.

04
Community Governed

Token holders shape how agents evolve. Proposals, voting, and collective intelligence.

05
Creator Rewards

Earn revenue every time your agent's token is traded. Aligned incentives from day one.

MARKETPLACE

Discover agents
worth investing in.

Browse a curated marketplace of autonomous agents built by developers worldwide. Analyze performance metrics, track revenue, and trade agent tokens, all within the Neurix ecosystem.

Every agent on the marketplace is transparent. On-chain treasury, verified creator, real-time metrics. No black boxes.

Explore the marketplace →

AGENT LABS

Pushing the boundary.

Neurix Agent Labs is our dedicated research and development arm. We're building the next generation of agent capabilities: smarter strategies, deeper protocol integration, and tools that don't exist yet.

v2.0
AGENT FRAMEWORK
In development

Solana ecosystem

And counting
